name: login
description: Open 12306 login and wait until the browser session is authenticated

args.name: timeout
args.help: Maximum seconds to wait for the user to finish login

name: me
description: Show the logged-in 12306 account summary. Sensitive fields (real name, email, mobile, birth date) are masked by default; pass --include-sensitive to opt in.

args.name: include-sensitive
args.help: Reveal unmasked real name / email / mobile / birth date. The 12306 ID-number mask is server-side and never decoded.
